messages:
Iris: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we keep seeing a recurring tail-latency pattern on long multi-turn prompts every ~3 weeks. Proposal: codify incident-driven evals + a recurrence-tracking column in the postmortem and rotate owners for remediation.

Ben: Agree. I'll own adding the curated regression promptset and include classification why each prompt regresses (e.g., KV cache eviction, long-token attention blowup). ETA 7 business days.

Hannah: I'll extend perf jobs with stepped batching and a mixed-load profile (steady background + 30s spikes) to emulate the real recurrence. Also add a monthly run to catch slow trend regressions. ETA 10 days.

Keiko: I'll add a small chaos drill that simulates intermittent KV cache loss and model fallback. Plan: record a playback run and capture traces. Will schedule first run off-peak next Friday.

Iris: Acceptance criteria suggestion: curated promptset must have <2% absolute quality drop vs golden; nightly regression delta alert >1.8% posts failing cases to #eng-ml; delta >2.8% auto-create RD-3602 draft and page owners. Also add a recurrence counter field in the postmortem artifact that increments on each regression detection.

Ben: I'll put promptset at infra/evals/incident-2002/curated.json and include golden_outputs.tgz + provenance (model hash, seed, capture timestamp). Will scrub PII.

Hannah: CI plan: fast pre-merge smoke (top 3 prompts), nightly full run, and monthly trend-run that compares rolling 30-day baseline. If monthly trend shows progressive drift, mark incident as "recurring" in the postmortem and trigger retro.

TicketBot: Created ticket RD-3602 "Incident-driven evals + recurrence tracking: incident-2002" and linked to board "Platform: Incident Remediation".

Keiko: Chaos run checklist: notify PD, disable auto-scaling for the window, ensure runbook has rollback, collect traces + model metrics. I'll attach the runbook to RD-3602.

Iris: For owner rotation: rotate primary owner every 3 weeks for recurring issues so we spread institutional knowledge. Add owner rotation note to the ticket and the eval PR template.

Ben: PR checklist snippet I'll add:
```
- purpose: add incident-2002 promptset
- dataset: infra/evals/incident-2002/curated.json
- golden: infra/evals/incident-2002/golden_outputs.tgz
- reproduce: ./tools/run_eval --suite incident-2002 --seed 42
- owner-rotation-note: primary owner rotates every 3w
```

Hannah: Alerting: nightly regression fail >1.8% posts top 5 failing prompts to #eng-ml + attaches artifacts; >2.8% opens RD-3602 P1 draft and pages current primary owner. I'll wire the webhook.

Keiko: I'll run the first chaos experiment next Friday 02:00 UTC and post results in this thread.

Iris: Thanks all. Summary: owners (Ben promptset, Hannah CI/perf, Keiko chaos), ticket RD-3602 created, first chaos run next Fri, weekly check-ins until 3 clean monthly trend runs. If anything blocks, ping me or drop a quick update here. :thumbsup:
